requirements.title: Street Use Franchise Utility Permit application
requirements.detail: Filed online in Accela Citizen Access by a registered company.

source.label: Fort Worth UT permit submittal guide

requirements.title: Engineering plans with cover sheet
requirements.detail: Cover sheet with work limits, requested working days, a 24-hour contact and a table of contents. Show trenches, bores, right-of-way, curbs, driveways, sidewalks, landscaping and nearby utilities, with bore and trench lengths and depths. Engineer's name and the final date on every sheet.

requirements.title: Plans in 10 working days before construction
requirements.detail: One electronic copy. Service-connection plans need 5 working days.

requirements.title: Traffic control plan, formatted like the engineering plans
requirements.detail: Follows the current MUTCD. Downtown and arterial streets: one lane closed at most, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM unless extended. Other streets: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

requirements.title: Contractor bond and certificate of insurance
requirements.detail: The City's contractor requirements point to a $25,000 streets and storm drain contractor bond and a basic insurance sheet. Confirm current amounts with the City.

source.label: Fort Worth Franchise Utility Permitting Guidelines

requirements.title: SWPPP, TCEQ coverage and grading permit
requirements.detail: Needed when the project disturbs 1.0 acre or more.

requirements.title: Doorhangers 7 days and 1 day before work
requirements.detail: Every resident on each block. Work cannot begin until they are delivered.

requirements.title: 48-hour customer, HOA and neighborhood notice
requirements.detail: Notice names the utility and contractor, a 24/7 contact, start date, type of work and expected duration. The policy and the guidelines page give different notice windows, so confirm which the inspector expects.

source.label: Fort Worth Franchise Utility Permitting Guidelines

requirements.title: Project sign at each end, 48 hours before start
requirements.detail: Shows the expected timeline and work area. A contractor notification sign is also required.

requirements.title: Utility locates before construction
requirements.detail: Through Texas One-Call or equivalent. City water or sewer lines 16 inches or larger need hydro-excavation verification.

requirements.title: Cross-street utilities must be bored
requirements.detail: Unless the director approves otherwise. Minimum cover is 42 inches under pavement and 24 inches in the parkway. Driveways should be bored where possible.

requirements.title: Bore under tree drip lines; no cutting roots 2 inches or larger
requirements.detail: No excavation, grading or storage inside the drip line. Cutting large roots on right-of-way trees needs City Forester approval first.

source.label: Fort Worth Franchise Utility Permitting Guidelines

requirements.title: Director approval to cut pavement under two years old
requirements.detail: Concrete needs full-slab replacement. Asphalt needs a 2-inch mill and overlay, curb to curb and block to block.

requirements.title: Start within 30 calendar days of approval
requirements.detail: Otherwise the permit is void. Extension requests are due 3 working days before it expires.

requirements.title: Permit, traffic control plan and plans kept on site
requirements.detail: A person who can make decisions must be on site while work is active.

requirements.title: Red-lines within 30 days of each segment; as-builts within 30 days of completion
requirements.detail: As-builts are delivered as PDF. This is a closeout item, not part of the first submittal.

requirements.title: Emergency work: notify and apply within 24 hours
requirements.detail: Include a written description. Temporary repairs become permanent within 14 calendar days.
